post_text: Don't like something it made? Just say so. "Make it dark green." "Add a leaderboard." "Bigger buttons." It rebuilds around your change. No settings, no menus — you just talk to it.

Small business owners: the tool you keep wishing you had probably takes 2 minutes now. Booking form, price calculator, service checklist, quote builder. Describe it, get it, share the link with customers.
Every app you make gets its own link instantly. No hosting to set up, no deploy button, nothing to install. Send it to your mum and it just opens on her phone.

post_text: New gallery is live — real apps people built, and you can Remix any of them into your own copy and change whatever you want.
I made this because small ideas kept dying in the gap where you'd need a developer for something that should take minutes. That gap shouldn't exist any more.
Free to try — a couple of builds on the house, no card needed. If you've ever thought "there should be an app for that", now there can be.
Teachers, coaches and trainers: quiz games, progress trackers, workout timers, flashcards. Describe what your students or clients need and hand them a link the same day.
Still my favourite part — you can download any app you make as a single file. It's yours forever, works offline, runs anywhere. No lock-in.
